questions.q: In Indian classical music, a tala is:
questions.why: Tala is the rhythmic cycle; raga is the melodic framework.

questions.q: Which instrument is associated with Irish folk music?
questions.why: The bodhrán is an Irish frame drum.

options: A cycle whose points are marked by gongs
Music in two keys at once
questions.why: Gongs mark fixed points in the repeating cycle.

questions.q: Describe two features of West African drumming.
questions.model: Several drums play different rhythms together (polyrhythm), with call and response between leader and group; a master drummer improvises over repeated ostinati.
